description: Dauerzählstelle Radverkehr Schnettkerbrücke is a dataset listed in Open Data Dortmund, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Stadt Dortmund. Dauerzählstelle Radverkehr Schnettkerbrücke Dortmund ab 23.01.2018. Die Förderung der Nahmobilität ist ein zentrales Ziel im Masterplan Mobilität 2030, dem Verkehrsentwicklungsplan der Stadt Dortmund. Coverage: Dortmund. The portal files it under Traffic. Its keywords are Fahrrad, Historie. The portal shows 304,421 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Datenlizenz Deutschland - Zero- Version 2.0 (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-open-data-dortmund-de-portal.
